God’s University of Life

Think of this as the path map: the different rhythms gathered on one page, without turning every section into a fresh introduction.

Use this page to choose a pace. Use University map for the five anchor verses, Courses for the full catalog, and Explore for the whole site map.

The Teacher is the Holy Spirit; the textbook is the KJV. Pick a short lane, read in context, pray honest lines, and let progress stay on this device until you sign in on purpose.

Seven-day lanes

When one hard week needs a short tether, these plans stay one verse a day—plain help, a step, a prayer. Open all Battle Plans to search or filter.

  • 7-Day Peace — when noise won’t quiet.
  • 7-Day Trust in Uncertainty — small footholds when tomorrow feels thin.
  • Forgiveness (7 days) — slow steps, not a single swallow.
  • Worry to Trust — when your mind will not unclench.
  • 7-Day Healing from Grief & Loss — one line of Scripture a day, no rush to “move on.”
  • More 7-day rows on Battle Plans (anger, fear, parenting, and others).

Twenty-one–day lane

Three weeks so a rhythm can stick—still one verse a day, still gentle.

  • 21-Day Battle — the site’s hand-built three-week path.

Thirty– and forty–day lanes

Longer horizons when you are not in a hurry—wilderness and strength language on purpose, not achievement language.

  • 30-Day Strength — a gentle month when strength feels gone.
  • 30-Day Battle — a month of one-verse footholds.
  • 40-Day Wilderness — trust, provision, and temptation in seasons that feel long.
  • 30-Day Praise & Thanksgiving — gratitude that becomes a rhythm.

Read, study, remember

  • Chapter reader — full chapters in KJV when you need the room around a verse.
  • Bible tool — lookup, verse image, and study doorway.
  • Memorize — cards and gentle review; private on this device.
  • My Study — saved verses, notes, and highlights; optional account sync is yours to turn on.
  • Progress — quiet visit rhythm and local plan streaks (not a report card).

Family, print, pastors

  • Family hub — table-level doorway for memory, plans, and paper.
  • Print hub — verse cards, calm sheets, family packs.
  • Church sharing kit — handouts and QR-friendly help for the room you serve.
  • For pastors & teachers — sermon and team tools in one list.

Audio & the public API

Many plans and verses include a calm Listen control on the day card; chapters cache for offline when you’ve opened them online once.

A small Hono API may be offered for partners who need the same KJV data in their own app shell—ask through contact if that would serve your church or school stack. Nothing here replaces personal Bible study; it routes people to the Word.

Pray with quiet company

Prayer — a short line on the wall or a private note; Home if you need to name how you feel first.
